_doc: PINNED exceptions for check-module-dependency-graph.mjs (Equoria-q4uem.4, WS4 S5).
Two sections, both of which may only SHRINK: the check FAILS on any observed
exception that is not listed here, AND on any listed entry that no longer matches
anything on disk (delete stale entries; nothing can be grandfathered quietly).
deepImports — the Equoria-hk739 TDZ carve-outs: cross-module deep imports whose
Key: `<importing file> -> <imported file>` (repo-relative POSIX paths). WS4 S6 converts
them to barrel imports, makes rule R2 strict and empties this section.
testBlockControllers — controller handlers re-exported from a barrel INSIDE a block
opened by the label `// Test-consumed only (… Equoria-7t1tn` (consumed only by other
modules' tests; controller ruling 3a). Key: `<module>.<exported name>`. Equoria-7t1tn
moves those tests into the owning module and empties this section.
Every entry MUST carry a `reason` (>= 40 chars) and an `issue` (Equoria-…).
